paragraphs: It is a sports lesson at school. Teacher Kim has a big book. The book is about sports. It has many pictures. She writes on the board. "Look at the board, class," she says. "I see football, tennis, and badminton!" says Mia.

Leo asks, "Can we play badminton?" "Yes, we can," says Teacher Kim. "Lily, where is the box?" Lily finds the box behind the door. Teacher Kim opens it. There are five balls in the box. The box has no badminton things. Leo looks sad. Mia looks at Leo.

"We can not play badminton today," says Teacher Kim. "But we can play with the balls." "Let's throw and catch!" Leo gets a red ball. He throws it to Lily. Lily catches it with two hands. Leo smiles. The class plays with the balls. Teacher Kim writes "badminton" on the board. "Badminton is for a new lesson," she says. "Hooray!" says Leo.
text.summary: Leo asks Teacher Kim for badminton in the sports lesson. The box has only balls, so the class throws and catches, and badminton is for a new lesson.
